cohort: 141 women (121 singleton and 20 twin pregnancies) who underwent cervical cerclage for cervical insufficiency at Tongji Hospital, Wuhan, China from January 1, 2010 to July 31, 2015
finding: Patients with a history of preterm labor and cervical length >25 mm in the current pregnancy, possibly in a twin pregnancy, could benefit from elective cervical cerclage; however, cervical cerclage was not advisable for twin pregnancies with a cervical length >15 and <25 mm.
mod_finding: There was no difference in mode of delivery between the singleton and twin groups.
gest_age: Singleton: 34.22 weeks, Twin: 28.27 weeks (mean at birth)
